candidate.answerReason: A median divides the triangle into two equal areas, so the area of triangle ABD is 30 ÷ 2 = 15 cm².

methods.label: Halve the total area
methods.explanation: A median divides a triangle into two parts of equal area, so the area of \(\triangle ABD\) is \(30\div2=15\).
